name: us022-force-bypasses-and-records
description: T022 [US2, contracts/run-state.md §3 row 1, §4]: --force always bypasses the state read and performs a full reconcile even on its own just-recorded, byte-matching state, and still records on success. Two runs of --force over the same spec share one mock process: run 1 records state, run 2 (same inputs) must still issue every request rather than short-circuiting on the state run 1 left behind.
